posts.text: FT: St. Kevin's 1-14 Rathangan 0-16. WE'RE IN THE COUNTY FINAL! 🔴⚫ Unbelievable scenes in Newbridge. Thank you to everyone who travelled!

posts.text: The new club walkway is now open to the public every day from 7am–10pm. A huge thank you to all the volunteers and sponsors who made it happen. 🔴⚫

posts.text: Well done to our U14 girls, crowned Division 2 league champions after an unbeaten season! 👏 Report and photos on the club website.
